content:
`issue_bank_letter` creates a general certificate without an addressee argument. `issue_attested_bank_letter` includes an addressee. Both use the bank profile at issuance.

A platform can require the addressed form. Both documents remain immutable after later legal or bank updates. A new issue date does not change the underlying bank name being attested.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `issue_attested_bank_letter`

Issue an immutable letter from the bank profile to a named addressee.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |
| `addressee` | string | yes | The addressee printed on the letter. |

Read only: `true`. Customer approval required before execution: `false`.

### `issue_bank_letter`

Issue an immutable account certificate describing the bank profile at issue time.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |

Read only: `true`. Customer approval required before execution: `false`.
